Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
reyda wrote:
>
> hi !
> -i bleed for 1. my prey intercepts with a vampire with 0 blood. i play
> burning touch. if he forced to decline to block ?

No.

> -I bleed for 1. my prey intercepts. I play burning touch but he plays
> obedience to avoid combat. i guess he still burns blood ?

Yes.

> - i bleed for 1. my prey intercepts. i play burning touch, then as he still
> wants to block, change of target. does he still bruns one blood off the
> wannabe interceptor ?

Yes. Can't play CoT until the block succeeds.

> -i bleed for 1. my prey intercepts. i play burning touch, and as he still
> wants to block , kiss of ra inferior. Does he burns 3 blood in total ?

No. KoR is played before the block succeeds.
